fullDescription: A high-impact, high-contrast dark mode portfolio style designed for personal branding, professional mentors, and educational institutes. Characterized by 'Clash Grotesk' bold italic editorial typography and a signature red accent (#DC2626) against a deep black (#000000) backdrop. The aesthetic combines industrial brutalism with modern SaaS elegance, featuring large-scale type stacks, subtle gradient light leaks, and a structured contact information grid. Ideal for design professionals, tech influencers, and creative directors looking for a commanding digital presence.

structured.summary: A bold, professional dark-themed hero page featuring massive italicized display typography, a signature red accent color, and a high-contrast layout designed to emphasize personal authority and professional services.

style.description: The style is defined by aggressive, high-contrast typography and a stark 'Night' theme. It uses a combination of 'Clash Grotesk' for high-impact headlines and 'Satoshi' for clean, readable body text. The primary color palette is #000000 (Black), #FFFFFF (White), and #DC2626 (Vibrant Red). Layout depth is achieved through subtle zinc-colored gradient overlays and soft drop shadows on text elements. Micro-interactions focus on clean icon placement and structured spacing.
style.prompt: Create a high-contrast dark design system. Background: Solid #000000 with a diagonal gradient light source (from #52525B to transparent at 12 degrees). Primary Accent: #DC2626 (Red). Typography: Use 'Clash Grotesk' for headers - specifically font-weight 800, italic, with line-height 0.95 and letter-spacing tight. Hero headings should be between 100px and 120px. Use 'Satoshi' for body text at 20px-24px. Icons should be housed in 56px x 56px circular containers. Apply drop-shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 10px blur) to large text to ensure separation from dark backgrounds. Borders should be subtle (white/15% opacity).

layout_and_structure.description: A top-down hierarchical layout starting with a centered brand header, transitioning into a split hero section (7:5 ratio), and concluding with a structured 3-column contact grid and a full-width location footer.

prompts.prompt: Centered layout. Top: A geometric logo mark using red #DC2626 (graduation cap style). Middle: Brand name in 48px semi-bold Clash Grotesk, contrasting white and red text. Bottom: A secondary tagline in a different script/language (e.g., Arabic or Urdu) at 36px font-size, centered with 8px top margin.

12-column grid layout. Left side (7 columns): Vertical stack of four text blocks in 'Clash Grotesk' Extrabold Italic. First block in #DC2626, remaining three in #FFFFFF. Font size 116px, line-height 0.95. Right side (5 columns): Large professional portrait with a soft white glow (#FFFFFF/10% opacity) behind the image for separation. The portrait should be bottom-aligned to the text stack.

Three-column horizontal strip. Each column features a centered 56px black circle containing a red #DC2626 icon. Below the icon, display contact details (email, phone, etc.) in 20px Satoshi font. Add vertical 1px borders (white/20% opacity) between the columns to create a distinct modular feel.

Full-width section with a 1px top border (white/15% opacity). Centered layout containing a 24px red location pin icon followed by address text in 24px semi-bold Satoshi. Padding should be 20px top/bottom to ensure visual breathing room.

special_ui_components.description: A custom SVG-style graduation cap with circuit board details.
special_ui_components.prompt: Construct a logo using clip-paths: A red #DC2626 diamond top (polygon 50% 0, 100% 35, 50% 70, 0 35) and a trapezoidal base. Include 'tech' elements like small 6px circular dots and 2px vertical lines inside the shape to signify 'IT' or 'Digital' education.

special_ui_components.description: High-contrast circular icon buttons with descriptive labels.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 56px circular background of #000000. Inside, center a 32px icon in #DC2626. Below the circle, place centered text in #FFFFFF at 90% opacity, Satoshi 20px. The interaction should feel like an information card rather than just a link.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use 'Clash Grotesk' in its italic weight for all primary headings to maintain the sense of speed and professionalism. MUST: Keep the background absolute black (#000000) to allow the red accents to pop. MUST NOT: Use borders heavier than 1px. MUST NOT: Use standard sans-serif fonts; the specific pairing of Grotesk and Satoshi is critical for the 'design-mentor' aesthetic.
